def _cart_position(event, item, membership=None, subevent=None):
    return CartPosition(
        item=item, price=Decimal('23.00'), expires=now() + timedelta(days=1), event=event, cart_id="123",
        used_membership=membership, subevent=subevent,
    )


def _create_membership_order(event, customer, positions):
    q = event.quotas.create(size=None, name="foo")
    for p in positions:
        q.items.add(p.item)
    return _create_order(event, email='dummy@example.org', positions=positions,
                         now_dt=now(),
                         sales_channel=event.organizer.sales_channels.get(identifier="web"),
                         payment_requests=[{
                             "id": "test0",

                             "max_value": None,
                             "min_value": None,

                             "payment_amount": Decimal("23.00"),
                         }],
                         locale='de', customer=customer)[0]

@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_max_usages_existing_order(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket):
    membership.membership_type.max_usages = 1
    membership.membership_type.save()
    order = _create_membership_order(event, customer, [
        CartPosition.objects.create(
            item=requiring_ticket, price=23, expires=now() + timedelta(days=1), event=event, cart_id="123",
            used_membership=membership,
        )
    ])
    assert order.positions.first().used_membership == membership

    cp = _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event)
    # The order being changed must not count against its own membership usage
    validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event, ignored_order=order)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_parallel_usage_in_purchase(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket, subevent):
    other_subevent = event.subevents.create(name='Bar', date_from=subevent.date_from)
    cps = [
        _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership, subevent=subevent),
        _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership, subevent=other_subevent),
    ]
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, cps, event)

    membership.membership_type.allow_parallel_usage = True
    membership.membership_type.save()
    validate_memberships_in_order(customer, cps, event)


@pytest.mark.django_db
def test_validate_memberships_parallel_usage_existing_order(event, customer, membership, requiring_ticket, subevent):
    other_subevent = event.subevents.create(name='Bar', date_from=subevent.date_from)
    _create_membership_order(event, customer, [
        CartPosition.objects.create(
            item=requiring_ticket, price=23, expires=now() + timedelta(days=1), event=event, cart_id="123",
            used_membership=membership, subevent=subevent,
        )
    ])
    cp = _cart_position(event, requiring_ticket, membership, subevent=other_subevent)
    with pytest.raises(ValidationError):
        validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event)

    membership.membership_type.allow_parallel_usage = True
    membership.membership_type.save()
    validate_memberships_in_order(customer, [cp], event)
